name: X Bookmarks to Markdown
description: Export the X bookmarks shown on x.com/i/bookmarks to a Markdown file. Reads the page only: no network, no storage.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'none'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'unsafe-inline'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'
